## ⛔ PLANNING RECONCILIATION — 2026-09-04

**ALREADY SHIPPED — voided, do not work.** CORE-7159 landed via **PR #201** (merge 78385e2, `justinassimutis/core-7159-rf-shared-legal-page-content-to-footer-gap-off-at-every`) and is at **Ready for QA** in Linear, awaiting human QA only. Verified against git log on main 2026-09-04.

Measurements retained for whoever picks up the related rows (from retired legacy task T25, report `reports/T25-CORE-6999-verification.md`): the defect was confined to **8 legal/policy pages out of 92** (8 control pages measured 48/48 cells at 0px difference); the clone was **looser** below 1440 and tighter above; the 1590–1799 band measured **-30px**; and the target value `pb-0 mb-[50px] min-[1023px]:mb-[75px] min-[1590px]:mb-[110px]` gave **48/48 exact matches** to live. On those 8 pages the spacing is stored in **CMS data** (`{"paddingBottom":"l","gap":"inherit"}`), so a code-only change may not have moved them — which is exactly what **T9 (CORE-6999)** must now re-measure.

Related still-open row: **T9 · CORE-6999**, and in Linear **CORE-7340** (same metric, opposite sign, `/compare-packages/llp/`).
acceptanceCriteria: Legal-page final-content → footer gap matches live at 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1440 / 1590 / 1800 (the 1590–1799 band is a distinct step on live and must be covered, not interpolated).
Verified on the affected legal/policy pages AND on control pages that already match, showing no regression on the latter.
State explicitly whether the 8 pages carrying `{"paddingBottom":"l","gap":"inherit"}` in CMS data are fixed by this change or still need a data edit — that determines whether T9/CORE-6999 can close.
Measured on the deployed clone, with the per-breakpoint table in the report.
